title: TAT-3851 Perps Top movers section
description: Proves the Perps tab renders a Top movers section with a working Gainers/Losers toggle and a header that opens the market list pre-sorted by 24h price change.

proofTargets.claim: The Perps tab shows a Top movers section with a Gainers/Losers toggle, Gainers selected by default.
Selecting Losers re-sorts the visible pills in place; the section stays mounted and no skeleton reappears.
Clicking the Top movers header opens the market list pre-sorted by 24h price change in the selected direction.
The section renders a skeleton while live market data is still loading.

gate-unlock-wallet.intent: The wallet is open, so the Perps tab is reachable rather than sitting behind the lock screen.

gate-open-perps.intent: Reach the Perps tab, where the Top movers section lives.

gate-perps-loaded.intent: The Perps tab has finished loading, so the movers ranking reflects real market data rather than an empty state.

gate-scroll-to-section.intent: Bring the Top movers section into the viewport, the way a user scrolling the Perps tab would.

ac1-wait-section.intent: A user browsing the Perps tab can see the Top movers section.

ac1-wait-gainers-active.intent: Gainers is the direction the section opens on, so the first thing a user sees is the biggest risers.

ac1-wait-losers-inactive.intent: The Losers half of the toggle is offered but not selected, so the toggle reads as a two-way choice.

ac1-wait-pill-grid.intent: The ranked markets are on screen rather than an empty or errored section.

ac1-read-gainers-order.intent: Record which markets the Gainers view is showing, so the Losers view can be compared against it.

ac1-clear-capture-orphans.intent: Clear orphan capture-helper processes so the image comes from capture-helper rather than the silent fallback.

ac1-screenshot-section.label: AC1: Top movers section on the Perps tab with Gainers selected and eight ranked pills
ac1-screenshot-section.intent: Show a reviewer the Top movers section as a user sees it, with Gainers selected.

ac2-press-losers.intent: A user switches the section to the biggest fallers.

ac2-scroll-to-section.intent: Keep the Top movers section in the viewport after the direction switch.

ac2-wait-losers-active.intent: The Losers half of the toggle now reads as the selected one.

ac2-wait-gainers-inactive.intent: Only one direction is selected at a time, so the toggle is not showing both as active.

ac2-wait-no-skeleton.intent: Switching direction re-sorts what is already loaded instead of dropping back to a loading state.

ac2-wait-section-still-mounted.intent: The list of markets stays on screen through the switch, so nothing flashes away and back.

ac2-read-losers-order.intent: Record the markets the Losers view is showing, so the change from the Gainers view is on record.

ac2-clear-capture-orphans.intent: Clear orphan capture-helper processes so the image comes from capture-helper rather than the silent fallback.

ac2-screenshot-losers.label: AC2: Losers selected; the same section now lists falling markets with negative changes
ac2-screenshot-losers.intent: Show a reviewer that the same section, still on screen, now ranks the biggest fallers.

ac3-scroll-to-header.intent: Bring the Top movers heading into reach so it can be tapped like a user would.

ac3-press-header.intent: A user taps the Top movers heading to see the full ranked market list.

ac3-wait-market-list.intent: The tap lands the user on the full market list.

ac3-wait-sort-preset.intent: The market list arrives already sorted by 24h price change rather than the default volume sort.

ac3-clear-capture-orphans.intent: Clear orphan capture-helper processes so the image comes from capture-helper rather than the silent fallback.

ac3-screenshot-market-list.label: AC3: market list opened from the Top movers header, sorted by price change ascending (Losers)
ac3-screenshot-market-list.intent: Show a reviewer the market list carrying the direction the user had selected in the section.

ac4-skeleton-unit-test.cmd: yarn jest ui/components/app/perps/perps-top-movers/perps-top-movers.test.tsx --no-coverage -t 'renders the loading skeleton while market data is loading'
ac4-skeleton-unit-test.intent: The section shows a skeleton, not an empty gap, while live market data is still arriving.

ac4-assert-test-ran.intent: Confirm the skeleton case actually executed instead of silently matching no test.

teardown-return-to-perps.intent: Leave the wallet back on the Perps tab for the next run.
